name: policy-fractions
description: Rounding policies (a scale or the currency's exponent, an increment, a mode and an optional currency) applied to multiplication, division, rounding, conversion, tax and exact amounts, and checked by assertScale, by Python's fractions module.

provenance.method: Python's fractions module, from the definitions in ducat's reference docs: every value an exact Fraction, rounded once at the end by the definition of each mode, with ties found by exact comparison.
